name: Umber
summary: A chocolate product page where each bar flips in, unwraps, and fills a gift box
about: A product page for a chocolate, coffee or snack brand with a few products to choose from. Each of the four bars flips in with its own colours, and the whole page morphs to match. Tap the bar to slide off the sleeve and peel the foil, add bars to a mini cart, and build a four-bar gift box that ties itself with a ribbon.
how: The bar drops in with a spin while the name, notes and price rise into place
Pick one of the four bars: the current bar tilts back, flips away edge-on and the new one flips in with a bounce while the page colours morph
Tap the bar to slide off the paper sleeve, peel the foil and watch the squares shine; tap again to wrap it
Set a quantity and press Add to box: a mini bar flies into the cart and the count bumps
Open Your box to change quantities, remove items and place a simulated order
Scroll to the gift box: add four bars, the lid closes and a ribbon ties itself, then add the whole box to the cart
